catalog.params: {relative: bool (true), extraW: pt (18), extraH: pt (18), width, height (absolute)}

catalog.label: Free Distort…
catalog.params: {corners: [[x,y]×4] new positions of the bounding-box corners TL, TR, BR, BL in unit box coordinates (identity [[0,0],[1,0],[1,1],[0,1]])}

catalog.label: Pucker & Bloat…
catalog.params: {amount: % (-200 pucker … 200 bloat, default 0)}

catalog.label: Roughen…
catalog.params: {size: 0..100 (5), relative: bool (true: % of size; false: pt), detail: per inch 0..100 (10), points: "smooth"|"corner", seed: int (0)}

catalog.label: Transform…
catalog.params: {scaleH: % (100), scaleV: % (100), moveH: pt (0; right = +), moveV: pt (0; down = +), rotate: deg (0; counter-clockwise), copies: 0..1000 (0; each copy transforms the last again), reflectX: bool (false; flips left to right), reflectY: bool (false; flips top to bottom), reference: 0..8 (4; the point of the bounds' 9-point grid it scales, rotates and reflects about: 0 top left, 4 centre, 8 bottom right), random: bool (false; each scale goes a random share of the way from 100 % to its value, each move and the angle a random share of theirs, differently for each object and the same on every redraw)}

catalog.label: Tweak…
catalog.params: {h: amount (10), v: amount (10), relative: bool (true: % of size), anchors: bool (true), in: bool (true), out: bool (true), seed: int (0)}

catalog.label: Zig Zag…
catalog.params: {size: (10), relative: bool (false: pt; true: % of size), ridges: per segment 0..100 (4), points: "smooth"|"corner"}

catalog.label: Offset Path…
catalog.params: {offset: pt (10; negative insets), joins: "miter"|"round"|"bevel", miterLimit: (4)}

catalog.label: Outline Stroke
catalog.params: {width?: pt (defaults to the stroke's weight)} the outline of the stroke the effect is on (on a fill or the object: the top stroke), with its caps, joins, dashes, alignment, width profile and arrowheads

catalog.label: Round Corners…
catalog.params: {radius: pt (10)}

catalog.label: Scribble…
catalog.params: {angle: deg (30), overlap: pt (0), strokeWidth: pt (3), curviness: % (5), spacing: pt (5), variation: pt (0.5), seed: int (0)} (simplified: a single hatching scribble outlined to a filled shape)

catalog.label: Drop Shadow…
catalog.params: {mode: blend mode ("multiply"), opacity: % (75), x: pt (7), y: pt (7), blur: pt (5), color: "#rrggbb" ("#000000")}

catalog.label: Inner Glow…
catalog.params: {mode: blend mode ("screen"), opacity: % (75), blur: pt (5), color: "#rrggbb" ("#ffffff"), source: "center"|"edge" ("edge")}

catalog.label: Outer Glow…
catalog.params: {mode: blend mode ("screen"), opacity: % (75), blur: pt (5), color: "#rrggbb" ("#ffff00")}

catalog.label: Feather…
catalog.params: {radius: pt (5)}

catalog.label: Gaussian Blur…
catalog.params: {radius: pt (5)}

catalog.label: Radial Blur…
catalog.params: {amount: 1..100 (10; spin: an arc of `amount`°, zoom: the content scaled by up to about ±amount/2 %), method: "spin"|"zoom" ("spin"), quality: "draft"|"good"|"best" ("good"; 16, 64 or 256 samples)} blurs around the object's centre

catalog.label: Smart Blur…
catalog.params: {radius: pt 0.1..100 (3), threshold: levels 0.1..100 (25; only colours closer than this blur together, so edges stay sharp), quality: "low"|"medium"|"high" ("medium"; 5, 7 or 9 samples across)} (Normal mode)

catalog.label: Unsharp Mask…
catalog.params: {amount: % 1..500 (50), radius: pt 0.1..250 (1; σ of the blur edges are found against), threshold: levels 0..255 (0; smaller differences are left alone)}

catalog.label: Glowing Edges…
catalog.params: {edgeWidth: pt 1..14 (2), edgeBrightness: 0..20 (6), smoothness: pt 1..15 (5)} finds alpha-weighted Sobel edges and draws bright coloured outlines on black

catalog.label: Color Halftone…
catalog.params: {maxRadius: pt 4..127 (8; the radius of a dot at full strength, which fills its square cell), channel1: screen angle deg -360..360 (108), channel2: deg (162), channel3: deg (90), channel4: deg (45)} screens each colour channel (red, green, blue: channels 1 to 3; in CMYK documents cyan, magenta, yellow, black: 1 to 4) at its angle into dots whose area follows the channel's mean over their cell

catalog.label: Crystallize…
catalog.params: {cellSize: pt 3..300 (10)} redraws the object as polygon crystals of solid colour around random points about cellSize apart

catalog.label: Mezzotint…
catalog.params: {type: "fineDots"|"mediumDots"|"grainyDots"|"coarseDots"|"shortLines"|"mediumLines"|"longLines"|"shortStrokes"|"mediumStrokes"|"longStrokes" ("fineDots")} turns each colour channel fully on or off against a random pattern of dots, lines or strokes: fully saturated colours

catalog.label: Pointillize…
catalog.params: {cellSize: pt 3..300 (5)} redraws the object as randomly placed dots of its colours on a white canvas

catalog.label: Craquelure…
catalog.params: {crackSpacing: pt 2..100 (15; how far apart the cracks are), crackDepth: 0..10 (6; how deep and wide the cracks are, and how high the plates and the tones stand), crackBrightness: 0..10 (9; how brightly the plaster is lit)} paints the object on relief plaster cracked into plates and along the contours of its tones

catalog.label: Grain…
catalog.params: {intensity: 0..100 (40), contrast: 0..100 (50; the image's contrast, 50 leaves it as it is), grainType: "regular"|"soft"|"sprinkles"|"clumped"|"contrasty"|"enlarged"|"stippled"|"horizontal"|"vertical"|"speckle" ("regular")} adds grain in 1 pt grains (2 pt Enlarged, clumps Clumped, streaks Horizontal and Vertical); Sprinkles and Stippled use the background colour, white

catalog.label: Mosaic Tiles…
catalog.params: {tileSize: pt 2..100 (12), groutWidth: 1..15 (3; the grout is half a point wide per step), lightenGrout: 0..10 (9; how light the grout is)} lays the object in irregular tiles bevelled at their edges, with sunken grout between them

catalog.label: Patchwork…
catalog.params: {squareSize: pt 0..10 (4; 0 draws 1 pt squares), relief: 0..25 (8)} redraws the object in squares of the colour around their centres, raised to heights that follow its highlights and shadows, a little more or less at random, lit from the top left

catalog.label: Stained Glass…
catalog.params: {cellSize: pt 2..50 (10), borderThickness: 1..20 (4; the lead between the panes, half a point wide per step, in the foreground colour: black), lightIntensity: 0..10 (3; a light behind the object's centre, fading out towards its corners)} redraws the object as single-coloured panes around random points about cellSize apart

catalog.label: Texturizer…
catalog.params: {texture: "brick"|"burlap"|"canvas"|"sandstone" ("canvas"; surfaces made in code), scaling: % 50..200 (100), relief: 0..50 (4), lightDirection: "bottom"|"bottomLeft"|"left"|"topLeft"|"top"|"topRight"|"right"|"bottomRight" ("top"), invert: bool (false; turns the surface's heights over)} paints the object on a surface in relief

catalog.label: De-Interlace…
catalog.params: {eliminate: "odd"|"even" ("odd"; which field lines are taken out), create: "duplication"|"interpolation" ("duplication"; a line taken out becomes a copy of the line above, or the average of the lines above and below)} the field lines are the rows of the document's raster grid (Document Raster Effects Settings › Resolution), numbered from 1 at the top of the page

catalog.label: NTSC Colors
catalog.params: {} makes colours a television signal can't carry (luma plus chroma past 110 % of white, or luma minus chroma below −20 %) less saturated, keeping their brightness

catalog.label: Brightness/Contrast…
catalog.params: {brightness: -100..100 (0; bends the tones, black and white stay), contrast: -100..100 (0)} recolours the object's fills, strokes, type, meshes and embedded images (each colour keeps its model)

catalog.label: Curves…
catalog.params: {points: "x,y x,y …" or [[x, y], …] (input, output 0..255; a smooth monotone curve through them, flat past the ends; "0,0 128,128 255,255"), channel: "rgb"|"red"|"green"|"blue" ("rgb")} recolours as Brightness/Contrast does

catalog.label: Hue/Saturation…
catalog.params: {hue: deg -180..180 (0), saturation: -100..100 (0), lightness: -100..100 (0), colorize: bool (false; true: every colour takes hue `hue` (0..360) at saturation (100 + saturation) / 2 %)} recolours as Brightness/Contrast does

catalog.label: Levels…
catalog.params: {inputBlack: 0..255 (0), inputWhite: 0..255 (255), gamma: 0.1..10 (1; above 1 lightens the midtones), outputBlack: 0..255 (0), outputWhite: 0..255 (255), channel: "rgb"|"red"|"green"|"blue" ("rgb")} recolours as Brightness/Contrast does

catalog.label: Shift to Color…
catalog.params: {color: "#rrggbb" ("#ff8000"), amount: 0..100 % (50), preserveLightness: bool (true: colours take the target's hue and saturation and keep their lightness; false: they mix with it)} recolours as Brightness/Contrast does

catalog.label: Temperature/Tint…
catalog.params: {temperature: -100 (cooler) .. 100 (warmer) (0), tint: -100 (greener) .. 100 (more magenta) (0)} recolours as Brightness/Contrast does
